subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should initial WhatsApp sticker support require sticker-ready WebP media, or should OpenClaw also convert arbitrary static and animated images into compliant stickers?
rationale: The action name, generic media input, Baileys transport, and tests already exist; conversion ownership materially expands the supported contract, dependency behavior, and validation burden and cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Require sticker-ready WebP
options.body: Ship a bounded explicit sticker action that validates supplied WebP media and returns actionable errors for unsupported input.

options.title: Add full image conversion
options.body: Accept common static and animated image formats and own resize, WebP encoding, animation, and sticker metadata compatibility.

recommendation.title: Require sticker-ready WebP
recommendation.body: Ship a bounded explicit sticker action that validates supplied WebP media and returns actionable errors for unsupported input.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across the shared message-action contract, WhatsApp outbound delivery, and prior product review of this exact issue.
